references.text: Here is told of the rebellion of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram against Moses and Aaron, which is the event referred to in Num. 26:9.
Dathan and Abiram refused to come when Moses called them, and they accused Moses of having brought them out of Egypt.
Describes how the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan and Abiram along with their families as punishment for the rebellion.
Moses reminds the Israelites of what the Lord did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, when the earth opened up and swallowed them.
The psalm mentions the rebellion against Moses and Aaron in the camp, and how the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan and covered Abiram's group.
Eliab is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Reuben, and he was the father of Dathan and Abiram.
The continuation of the story of Korah's rebellion and how the earth swallowed them, but Korah's sons did not die.
